title: Normal force at C
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the normal force at point C (2.2 N) using energy conservation and Newton's second law for circular motion.

title: Minimum speed at C
description: Important: Applies the condition for maintaining contact at the top of the loop (centripetal force ≥ weight) to find the minimum speed.

title: Projectile time of flight
description: Important: Correctly calculates the time for the ball to fall from C to the ground or to the baffle height using vertical motion equations.

title: Horizontal landing range
description: Essential: Determines the correct range of landing coordinates (1 m to 2.68 m) from point O, based on projectile motion from C.

title: Energy conservation for O to C
description: Important: Uses work-energy theorem correctly to relate speed at O to speed at C for the farthest landing case.

title: Normal force at O
description: Essential: Calculates the normal force at point O (12.2 N) for the farthest landing case using Newton's second law for circular motion.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Makes sign errors in coordinate system or unit inconsistencies (e.g., forgetting g=10 m/s², misusing R=0.5 m).

title: Incorrect centripetal force direction
description: Pitfall: Misapplies Newton's second law at points O or C (e.g., wrong sign for forces in the centripetal equation).

title: Baffle clearance condition
description: Optional: Explicitly states the condition for clearing the baffle (horizontal distance L = v*t for fall from C to baffle height).
